Heinz Mayo Mash Ups

May the best sauce win.

ClientHeinz
ProjectUK launch of Heinz Mayo Mash Ups
What I didCreative concept development
AgencyHeinz The Kitchen. Produced by WXY.

Heinz fans go to irrational lengths. They get the logo tattooed. They smuggle Beanz through airport security. They keep sachets in their handbags, just in case.

Heinz doesn't just know this. It builds campaigns on it.

So when it noticed fans mixing sauces on the side of the plate, it launched three new Mayo Mash Ups. MayoRacha, MayoCue and MayoMust. The brief was to get 18 to 44s to make room for them in the fridge door.

Enter The Kitchen, Kraft Heinz's award-winning in-house creative agency. I joined them to crack the launch.

We came up with three routes: a Secret Sauce Society, Mash Up Songs, and one that tapped into the craze for challenge shows like Squid Game, Taskmaster and Physical 100.

Guess which one Heinz picked.

Three sauces. Three creators. Only one winner.

Welcome to The Sauce Games.

The idea became a short-form TikTok game show, produced by WXY. America Foster took MayoRacha. Abraham Bunga repped MayoCue. Morgan M-James went to war for MayoMust.

Blindfolds on. Burgers built by feel. Sauce going everywhere except the bun. Strangers stopped in the street and made to pick a side. The trash talk started before round one was over, right there in the captions.

When the confetti settled, MayoRacha took the crown.

But the real winner was Heinz. 3M+ views in 72 hours.
